headline: Borsa Istanbul's New Decision on BIST 50: Short Selling Rule Changed
summary: Borsa Istanbul said, following a Capital Markets Board decision, an up-tick rule will apply to short sales of eligible BIST 50 shares from the day of the announcement.
why: Short-selling rules govern how investors can bet against shares, affecting liquidity and price behaviour in Turkey's leading index.
